All other selected equations and values are confirmed by their own worked solutions. q-14191: setting y=0 gives 13x=2. q-73769: setting x=0 gives (y−13)(y+7)=0. q-79301: the vertex and supplied point give (y+1)²=4(x+4), hence y=−5 or 3 at x=0. q-79299: they give (x+4)²=2(y+4), hence y=4 at x=0. q-75314: the areas are 15/2 and 4, totaling 23/2. q-102668: substituting t=2x+5 gives y=4x(x+5)(2x+1). q-24378: cos(2t)=1−2sin²(t) gives the selected equation; the exact parametrized curve also requires −2≤x≤2, which the source omits. q-155954: trapezoid and triangle areas give 3/2+4=11/2. q-155955: trapezoid and rectangle areas give 6+2=8. q-90780: the net rate is 14+4t, so accumulation from the initial 100 gives 100+14t+2t². q-117666: splitting the integral at −1 gives 64+20=84. q-353388: rectangle area 12 plus semicircle area 2π gives 12+2π; the single-point discontinuity does not affect the integral. q-106419: x=t²/2 and y=t give y²=2x and cover the full parabola. q-84715: x=−3t²/2 and y=−3t give y²=−6x and cover the full parabola. q-84738: t=6x and t²=12y give x²=y/3.
